items.title: Structure-Based Annotation by AlphaFold3 Predictions of the Francisella halioticida T6SS Encoded in the Francisella Pathogenicity Island.
items.one_liner: Francisella halioticida has emerged as a significant pathogen of cultured molluscs, causing substantial economic losses due to mass mortalities. items.source: PubMed — Angewandte Chemie (International ed. in English)
